en.title: Highest Frequency in an Array
en.description:
Given a non-empty integer array, output the number of occurrences of the most frequent value.

The standard input/output, examples, and tests are written by CSWork; ranges marked "this site" are judging conventions and are not claimed to be original interview limits.
en.input: The first line contains n (1..100000); the second line contains n integers (−10⁹..10⁹).
en.output: Output the answer as described; results for multiple queries are separated by spaces, in order.
en.explanation: Example 1: the number 3 appears 4 times, the highest count. Example 2: −1 appears 3 times. Example 3: each of the three values appears 1 time, so the answer is 1.
hints: Count the occurrences of each value in a hash map, and take the maximum count.
